IC1: Malignancy [OR] and other significant medical conditions that will impact follow up within this program.
IC2: Those less than 18 years of age.
IC3: Concomitant interstitial lung disease [OR], sarcoidosis [OR], other significant lung disease.
IC4: Those who have had a transplant.
IC6: Unable to make appointments (every three to six months over 2 years).
IC7: Those residing in another country or planned absence for more than one month.
